name: Dubois Creek-Missouri River
places: St. Francis Borgia Regional High School
Our Lady of Lourdes Catholic School
about: Dubois Creek-Missouri River drains about 43 square miles, 4% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 800 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 470 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Dubois Creek, Browns Branch and Busch Creek. Downstream, its water passes through the Labadie Creek-Missouri River, Wildhorse Creek-Missouri River and Greens Chute-Missouri River watersheds on its way down the Missouri River, which joins the Mississippi River at the east end of St. Charles County.
